name: Unique Bid Auction
summary: Auction where the winner is the lowest, or highest, bid that no one else made.
rules_text: Players pay a fee per bid and secretly submit any number of penny-precise bids up to a cap. All submitted amounts are hidden until closing. At close, frequencies are counted. In the lowest-unique variant the smallest amount that was bid by exactly one player wins, and that player purchases the lot for that amount. In the highest-unique variant the largest amount bid by exactly one player wins. If no amount is uniquely bid, no one wins. Players may bid multiple times in the same auction.
rating_reason: Specific auction game, lowest unique wins, hidden bids, bluffing, arithmetic ranking
